1409-4826-7898.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts.
1409-4826-7898.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking Smaug.
When Smaug enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Smaug.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating a number of untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2447-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2447-3259-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2301-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2301-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1486-1719-1753-7176.description:
Activate Oko, Lorwyn Liege's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Vizier of Tumbling Sands to gain all creature types.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat from step 2.
1486-1719-1753-7176.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1753-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3490-4068-4289-7075.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
You control at least one Mountain.
3490-4068-4289-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2363-5220-6247.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and High-Society Hunter.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Hangarback Walker from your library.
Repeat.

719-4338-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4067-4306-4823-6281.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

575-1184-4677-4955.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
575-1184-4677-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Kin-Tree Warden.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kin-Tree Warden.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Kin-Tree Warden enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

140-1745-3245.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

92-1496-1738.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
92-1496-1738.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life when you gain life this turn.
Cast Serra Avatar by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Serra Avatar enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2011-5123-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender and Najeela do not have summoning sickness.
You control a blue and a black permanent.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
2011-5123-5168.description:
Declare Najeela and Bloom Tender as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1578-2713-2836-4621.description:
Cast Manamorphose by paying {1}{R/G}.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Guildmage by paying {U}, copying Manamorphose.
Resolve the Manamorphose copy, adding {1}{U} and drawing a card.
Repeat from step 2 until you draw from an empty library, winning the game.
